summary: This Snowflake documentation page describes the TO_XML function, which converts a VARIANT/semi-structured value into a VARCHAR containing its XML representation and returns NULL for NULL input. It explains the usage scenarios, including regenerating originally inserted XML and converting JSON-like values to XML-compatible form, and the type attributes Snowflake adds to generated tags for OBJECT and ARRAY values. Several examples show TO_XML applied to parsed XML, a constructed OBJECT, a constructed ARRAY, and parsed JSON.
one_line: Snowflake's TO_XML function converts a semi-structured value into an XML-formatted VARCHAR, with type attributes on generated tags.
key_facts: TO_XML(<expression>) converts a value to a VARCHAR that contains an XML representation of the value.
If the input to TO_XML is NULL, the result is also NULL.
The data type of the value returned by TO_XML is VARCHAR.
TO_XML can regenerate a string matching an originally inserted XML-formatted value.
For a value that did not originate as XML, Snowflake generates XML-compatible tags that may include a type attribute giving the Snowflake data type of the tag's contents.
The outermost tag for an OBJECT is similar to <SnowflakeData type="OBJECT"></SnowflakeData>.
For an OBJECT, each key-value pair's tags are based on the key, for example <key1 type="VARCHAR">value1</key1>.
For an ARRAY, each element is in a tag pair similar to <e type="VARCHAR"></e>.
The example of TO_XML on the parsed XML note '<note> <body>Sample XML</body> </note>' returns <note><body>Sample XML</body></note>.

Calling TO_XML on the OBJECT created by OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('key1', 'value1', 'key2', 'value2') returns <SnowflakeData type="OBJECT"><key1 type="VARCHAR">value1</key1><key2 type="VARCHAR">value2</key2></SnowflakeData>.
Calling TO_XML on the ARRAY created by ARRAY_CONSTRUCT('v1', 'v2') returns <SnowflakeData type="ARRAY"><e type="VARCHAR">v1</e><e type="VARCHAR">v2</e></SnowflakeData>.
Calling TO_XML on the JSON parsed from { "key1": ["a1", "a2"] } returns an OBJECT tag containing a key1 tag with type="ARRAY" and e elements a1 and a2.
The page lists TO_XML under the Snowflake function categories including JSON and XML Parsing and Conversion/Casting.
The function is enabled for all accounts.
